list.name: Changes
list.comment:
feat(enrichment): implement FBref + Understat enrichment pipeline (Phase 2)
- Add domain ports and DTOs for FBref/Understat providers and enrichment repository, keeping the enrichment layer cleanly separated from ingestion - Introduce fuzzy Jaccard name-matching service (normalize + token Jaccard + surname bonus/penalty) extracted from legacy logic; handles accented names and discards ambiguous matches - Implement FBrefScraper using httpx async + BeautifulSoup with data-stat attribute parsing (avoids pandas dependency); 4s rate limit between requests with 3-attempt retry - Implement UnderstatScraper extracting embedded JSON.parse() variable from HTML; handles unicode_escape encoding for non-ASCII player names; 2s rate limit - Add EnrichmentRepository with queries to find unmatched goal events, update external IDs, update player_stats only where API-Football left zeros, and apply delta-based season_score recalculation (preserves match-stats points not stored as individual events) - Add three use cases: EnrichWithFBref (PSxG + season stats), EnrichWithUnderstat (PSxG fallback skipping Champions League), RecalculateScores (delta approach on M4 recalculation to avoid overwriting match-stats contribution) - Wire Celery tasks for per-league and full-pipeline enrichment; add beat schedule at 2am/14pm UTC offset from ingestion hours (0/8/16 UTC) - Expose admin endpoints: /enrich-fbref, /enrich-understat, /enrich-all, /recalculate for manual triggering - Extend Player model with fbref_id and understat_id nullable unique fields; add migration SQL in comments - Add beautifulsoup4 and lxml to requirements

task.summary:
chore(repo): archive all source code into _archive/ — breakpoint snapshot
- Move all legacy scripts (api_events_endpoint, api_football_ingest_v5, fetch_photos, fix_positions, ingest_team, run, understat_merge_v2) into _archive/ to clean up the root - Move active backend/ package into _archive/ as a frozen reference snapshot before a full rewrite or restructure begins - Add _archive/README.md documenting each file's purpose and intent - Update .gitignore to exclude _archive/ from future AI context and tracking
BREAKING CHANGE: The backend/ package is no longer at the repo root. Any tooling, imports, or entry points referencing backend/ will break until the package is re-scaffolded in its new location.

feat(infra): bootstrap SFA backend infrastructure skeleton
- Scaffold hexagonal project layout under src/sfa/ (api, core, infrastructure, domain) to establish a clean separation of concerns from the start - Implement GET /api/v1/health endpoint that probes DB and Redis on every request, returning connection status without ever crashing with a non-200 - Configure three environment classes (Development/Production/Test) via pydantic-settings, selected by APP_ENV, mirroring the Django DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE pattern; SECRET_KEY raises ValueError at startup if missing - Wire async SQLAlchemy engine (asyncpg) and redis.asyncio client as FastAPI dependencies, keeping infrastructure isolated from business logic - Add Celery stub wired to CELERY_BROKER_URL so worker containers can start immediately - Split requirements into base/local/production/test to avoid installing dev tools in prod - Add environment-specific Dockerfiles and executable start scripts under django/development and django/production; set PYTHONPATH=/code/src in both images so the src/ layout is resolved correctly inside containers (fixes ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'sfa') - Provide docker-compose-development.yml and docker-compose-prod.yml with api, db (postgres:16-alpine), redis (7-alpine), and celery_worker services - Add GitHub Actions CI job that spins up Postgres and Redis services, runs flake8, isort, coverage (fail-under=80), and pytest - Configure flake8 (max 120, select E302/E501/F401/F821), isort (black profile), and pytest (asyncio_mode=auto) so linters and tests are reproducible locally and in CI - Add tests/test_health.py with three async cases (all-ok, db-error, redis-error) using dependency_overrides — no real infrastructure required to run the suite

feat(models): implement SFA v2.0 scoring schema changes
- Add CORNER_ASSIST to EventType enum to distinguish corner assists from regular assists, enabling correct 250 vs 500 pts base score assignment per position without ambiguity in the SFASeasonScore breakdown - Add played_at (timestamptz, NOT NULL) and matchday (SmallInteger, nullable) to Fixture so M1 can be resolved against the correct StandingSnapshot at match time; matchday is nullable to support cups and playoffs - Add matchday column to StandingSnapshot and include it in the unique constraint, enabling per-matchday snapshots required to compute M1 with historical accuracy instead of only end-of-season position - Rewrite PlayerStats to align with scoreable statistics: add xg, xa, dribbles_won, interceptions, corner_assists; rename aerial_duels_won to duels_won (total duels per API-Football); drop through_balls and recoveries_own_half which carry zero pts weight in the v2.0 formula - Add mvisit (Numeric(3,2), default=1.0, CHECK IN (1.0, 1.3)) to PlayerEvent to persist the away-team multiplier per event, enabling full traceability and future recalculation of pts if the factor changes

feat(domain): implement SFA scoring engine domain layer
- Add domain/scoring bounded context with four modules: value_objects, entities, services, and a public __init__ re-export — no existing files modified; the domain stays completely separate from infrastructure
- Define PositionGroup (FW/MF/DF) and ActionType (15 actions) enums plus position_to_group() which maps the 6 infra positions to scoring groups and raises ValueError for GK, keeping the aggregate uncorruptible
- Implement seven frozen-dataclass value objects (M1–M4, Mvisit, CombinedMultiplier, SFAScore), each validating and clamping its invariant at construction time so invalid states cannot be represented
- Define BASE_POINTS_TABLE as the single source of truth for all base-point values per group×action, including explicit 0 entries for actions that do not apply to a group (CORNER_ASSIST, DRIBBLES_WON, PROGRESSIVE_* etc.)
- Introduce SFAScoringService with two calculation paths: score_event() applies all five multipliers (M1–M4 + Mvisit) for individual events (goals/assists); score_match_stats() applies only M1 × M2 for per-match aggregated statistics that have no exact minute or PSxG
- Add Player, ScoredEvent (both frozen), and PlayerSeasonScore aggregate root whose total_pts is always derived from stored events, making it impossible to desync total from the event list from outside the class
- Validated against the document's worked example: van Dijk (DC, #3) scores away vs Arsenal (#1) in min 87 drawing, Champions groups → 1500 × 4.0 (clamped) = 6000 pts

feat(api): implement REST API v1 — ranking, players, competitions, compare, status
- Configure FastAPI with full OpenAPI metadata, Swagger UI at /docs, ReDoc at /redoc, and openapi_tags grouping endpoints by domain so the interactive docs are useful out of the box - Add Pydantic response schemas for all endpoints using ConfigDict(from_attributes=True) for SQLAlchemy row compatibility; CompareResponseSchema reuses PlayerDetailSchema to avoid duplicating the player shape - Implement GET /ranking with a single SQL query using RANK() OVER and optional filters by position/competition/season — replaces the O(n) Python sort in legacy - Implement GET /players/{id} with global_rank computed via COUNT subquery instead of a Python loop; GET /players/{id}/events now exposes m4 and mvisit absent in legacy; GET /players/{id}/fixtures aggregates SUM(pts)/COUNT(*) per match — new endpoint with no legacy equivalent - Extract _get_player_detail() as a shared internal function so GET /compare reuses it for both players without duplicating query logic - Implement GET /competitions with competition_factor aliased as factor for client compatibility; GET /competitions/{id}/standings resolves latest matchday via MAX() subquery when the param is omitted — replaces the single-snapshot legacy approach - Implement GET /status running async COUNT(*) over each table and returning system totals with the latest season and api_version from settings - Add REST Client .http files for manual testing of all endpoints including filter variants and expected 404 cases - Add docs/api-reference.md as a black-box reference for external consumers, independent of Swagger, documenting parameters, response shapes, and status codes

refactor(architecture): introduce hexagonal application + repository layers; wire use cases via FastAPI DI
- Add application use cases (get_ranking, get_player_detail, get_player_events, get_player_fixtures, get_standings, list_competitions, get_status, compare_players) to move all business logic out of route handlers — previously inline SQL lived directly in the API layer - Add infrastructure repositories (PlayerRepository, SFAScoreRepository, CompetitionRepository, StandingRepository, PlayerEventRepository, SystemRepository) as the persistence adapters implementing domain ports - Add domain/ports.py to define the port interfaces that use cases depend on, decoupling application logic from SQLAlchemy - Expand dependencies.py to wire repositories and use cases as FastAPI async dependencies, keeping DI declarative and testable without touching route signatures - Slim all five API routers (ranking, players, competitions, status, compare) to thin HTTP adapters: inject use case via Depends, call execute(), map result to response schema - Add pythonpath = src to pytest.ini so test modules resolve imports correctly without editable install - Add specs with plan.md

refactor: rename /django environment folder to /environment
BREAKING CHANGE: These make change in envs path in docker compose

feat(ingestion): implement API-Football data ingestion pipeline (Phase 1)
- Add FootballDataProviderPort and IngestionRepositoryPort protocols with raw DTOs (standings, fixtures, events, player stats) to define the ingestion contract in the domain layer - Introduce position_mapping module with BASE_POSITION_MAP and KNOWN_POSITIONS dict to resolve EXT/LAT positions that API-Football does not distinguish natively - Implement APIFootballProvider HTTP adapter using httpx with retry logic (3 attempts, 20s timeout, 10s backoff), rate-limit detection (65s pause on rateLimit error), ROUND_TO_STAGE mapping, and get_score_at_minute helper - Implement IngestionRepository with idempotent pg_insert upserts for all entities; team upsert uses a two-step strategy to link external_id to already-seeded rows before falling back to insert - Implement IngestCompetitionUseCase orchestrating the full pipeline: standings → fixture+event fetch for top-N teams → per-player SFA scoring (M1–M4+Mvisit computed individually for storage) → season score accumulation → ingestion log; GK excluded from event scoring, filters ≥20 min/fixture and ≥90 min/season - Add IngestAllCompetitionsUseCase wrapping the 6 configured leagues with a 7000-request safety guard - Wire Celery tasks as thin asyncio.run() wrappers and configure Beat schedule (every 8h, season 2024) with autodiscover - Expose admin endpoints POST /ingest/{league_id} and POST /ingest-all to trigger ingestion manually via Celery - Add external_id (nullable unique) to Player and Team models to link DB rows to API-Football IDs; add API_FOOTBALL_KEY and API_FOOTBALL_BASE_URL to BaseConfig; add httpx dependency and celery_beat service to docker-compose
BREAKING CHANGE: Player and Team tables require ALTER TABLE to add the external_id column before running the updated app (no Alembic migration included in this phase).

- Add domain ports and DTOs for FBref/Understat providers and enrichment repository, keeping the enrichment layer cleanly separated from ingestion - Introduce fuzzy Jaccard name-matching service (normalize + token Jaccard + surname bonus/penalty) extracted from legacy logic; handles accented names and discards ambiguous matches - Implement FBrefScraper using httpx async + BeautifulSoup with data-stat attribute parsing (avoids pandas dependency); 4s rate limit between requests with 3-attempt retry - Implement UnderstatScraper extracting embedded JSON.parse() variable from HTML; handles unicode_escape encoding for non-ASCII player names; 2s rate limit - Add EnrichmentRepository with queries to find unmatched goal events, update external IDs, update player_stats only where API-Football left zeros, and apply delta-based season_score recalculation (preserves match-stats points not stored as individual events) - Add three use cases: EnrichWithFBref (PSxG + season stats), EnrichWithUnderstat (PSxG fallback skipping Champions League), RecalculateScores (delta approach on M4 recalculation to avoid overwriting match-stats contribution) - Wire Celery tasks for per-league and full-pipeline enrichment; add beat schedule at 2am/14pm UTC offset from ingestion hours (0/8/16 UTC) - Expose admin endpoints: /enrich-fbref, /enrich-understat, /enrich-all, /recalculate for manual triggering - Extend Player model with fbref_id and understat_id nullable unique fields; add migration SQL in comments - Add beautifulsoup4 and lxml to requirements
